name: Greco di Bianco
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Calabria DOC for passito wines, made in the province of Reggio Calabria. It is made in the commune of Bianco and part of Casignana, from Greco Bianco.
